reuse.why: Reuses tag parsing, budget writes, averaging and undo infrastructure, but copyPreviousMonth bypasses the new shared category selection.

duplication.why: Consolidates the average actions while retaining a second implementation of month-wide eligibility in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: Budget selection and calculations remain in actions.ts, tag parsing uses the shared module, and handler registration follows app.ts conventions.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the requested budget actions, their registration, supporting tests and a relevant release note.

maintainability.why: The shared arguments and average dispatcher simplify maintenance, but eligibility changes still require coordinated edits in two implementations.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth independently applies eligibility instead of using getMonthWideBudgetCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts expresses hidden/template exclusions through SQL in getMonthWideCategories and through BudgetData fields and JavaScript guards in copyPreviousMonth, with income and fixed-group checks repeated across those paths.

abstraction_drift.where: The shared category selection accepts includeHiddenCategories as a requested variation without consumer-specific branches, but copyPreviousMonth continues to implement the selection rules separately.
